_comment: Sync record for spec/openapi.v1.yaml. Do not edit by hand; refresh it when re-syncing the spec.
spec/openapi.v1.yaml is a verbatim copy of the backend's public artefact (source.spec), not its full source-of-truth spec.
upstream_ssot_sha256 is the sha256 from the backend lock (source.lock); it identifies the backend version we synced against.
public_sha256 is the hash of the copied public artefact itself (same method: info.version excluded, canonical JSON, SHA-256); it detects hand edits to spec/openapi.v1.yaml.
Two hashes are needed because the backend lock hashes the full spec while this repo only ships the public derivative, so one value could never match both.

source.branch is where the backend currently publishes the lock and public artefact. It is "test" until they are promoted to "main"; then change this one field. Override at runtime with IMZALA_UPSTREAM_BRANCH or --branch.
